create_video_generation: create a video from a text prompt using the video generation endpoint
list_videos: list all available videos using the video list endpoint
get_video_status: get the status and metadata of a video by its ID
download_video_content: download raw video content bytes by video ID
remix_video: remix an existing video with a new prompt using the video remix endpoint
create_character_from_video: create a character from an uploaded video file with a name
edit_video: create a video edit job with a prompt and reference video ID
extend_video: create a video extension job with a prompt, seconds, and reference video ID
